rationale: Create one canonical R.E.L.A.M. rail-equipment leasing platform. Basalt closed its acquisition on May 28, 2026 through Basalt Infrastructure Partners V, and Paceline exited after forming the platform in 2020. The platform serves recurring rail-infrastructure maintenance and construction needs across the United States and Canada; subsidiaries, branches, fleet assets, lenders and advisers are not separate PortCos. No later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was found through August 19, 2026.

afterImage.description: R.E.L.A.M. is a North American lessor of specialized maintenance-of-way and hi-rail equipment used by railroads, rail contractors, transit authorities and other rail-infrastructure operators. Its services include operating and finance leases, rental-purchase programs, equipment sales, parts, repair, support and logistics. The platform is headquartered in Glenwillow, Ohio and has locations in the United States and British Columbia, with an approximately 1,500-asset fleet disclosed at the May 2026 transaction close. Paceline formed the platform in 2020 and exited when Basalt Infrastructure Partners completed its acquisition on May 28, 2026 through Basalt Infrastructure Partners V. The exact ownership percentage and legal acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed, and no later exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.
